meta.title: About | Gama Institute
meta.description: The mission, vision and values of Gama Institute.

hero.h1: Showcasing world-class research in artificial intelligence and software engineering, conducted in Quebec and francophone Africa.
hero.lead: GAMA Institute is a research, training and innovation institute dedicated to artificial intelligence and software engineering. We conduct world-class research in collaboration with universities, industry partners and the scientific community to train the next generation of researchers, turn scientific discoveries into concrete innovations, and make research accessible to the entire francophone world.

mission.h2: Advancing research. Training talent. Turning ideas into impact.
lead: Our mission is to produce world-class research in artificial intelligence and software engineering while developing the next generation of francophone scientific talent.

Through research projects, training programs, academic and industry collaborations, and science outreach initiatives, we bring researchers, students and organizations together to turn knowledge into innovations with real impact on society.

vision.h2: A scientific francophonie connected to the world
lead: We envision a future where talent from Quebec and francophone Africa (notably Cameroon, Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Mali, Gabon and Togo) collaborates naturally on large-scale research projects, publishes in top international conferences, and contributes together to advances in artificial intelligence and software engineering.

Our ambition is to make GAMA Institute a scientific bridge between Quebec and francophone Africa, building lasting connections between universities, industry and the scientific community to strengthen the international reach of francophone research.

items.title: Scientific excellence
items.body: We conduct rigorous, reproducible, peer-reviewed research to produce knowledge that is reliable and useful.

items.title: Collaboration
items.body: We believe the best breakthroughs happen when researchers, students, universities and companies work together, in Quebec and francophone Africa alike.

items.title: Accessibility
items.body: We make scientific knowledge accessible through outreach, training and shared learning, so discoveries can benefit as many people as possible.

items.title: Transmission
items.body: We invest in emerging scientific talent by giving students the chance to take part in research projects, build their skills and contribute to publications.

items.title: Impact
items.body: We develop research that goes beyond publications to produce tools, practices, collaborations and innovations that address real-world challenges.

pillars.lead: Each pillar reinforces the others, building an ecosystem where research feeds training, training grows talent, innovation turns discoveries into concrete solutions, and community drives scientific collaboration.

items.title: Research
items.body: Producing world-class research in artificial intelligence and software engineering, with a particular focus on reliable, responsible and trustworthy systems.

items.title: Training
items.body: Training the next generation of researchers and engineers through research projects, courses, mentorship and collaborations with our partner universities in Quebec and francophone Africa.

items.title: Innovation
items.body: Turning research results into software, tools, prototypes and industry collaborations with lasting impact.

items.title: Community
items.body: Building a scientific network between Quebec and francophone Africa by fostering collaboration among students, researchers, universities and industry partners.

history.h2: From an idea to a research institute
history.lead: Gama Institute was born from the conviction that software engineering and artificial intelligence must evolve together, with reliability as the first requirement.

items.title: First works
items.body: A group of researchers and engineers begins work on the reliability of AI systems.

items.title: Institute founded
items.body: Official creation of Gama Institute and definition of the five research areas.

items.title: Training launched
items.body: Launch of the first course catalogue and the first professional workshops.

items.title: WeekPaper & community
items.body: Start of the WeekPaper series and growth of an open community of practitioners.

items.title: Partnerships at scale
items.body: Academic, industry and government collaborations on responsible-AI projects.

cta.h2: Let's build the future of francophone research together
body: Whether you're a student, researcher, professor, professional or industry partner, join a community committed to advancing artificial intelligence and software engineering through research, collaboration and innovation.
Together, let's make Quebec and francophone Africa two hubs of scientific excellence that actively contribute to international advances in artificial intelligence and software engineering.
